clean_rebuild_policy: Repeat the clean optimization from the same seed, same owner facts and same hyperparameters; compare every f32 parameter bit. Rebuild compute is charged.
parent_policy: Always use the previous stage trained artifact, selected again after all interventions regardless of future scores. Frozen keeps parent arrays and rebases support. Catalog old outputs are mapped by complete typed value; new columns use the same seeded random initializer.
zero_policy: Same current support, catalog where applicable, threshold, shape and budget; initialization only, zero gradient steps.
frozen_policy: Stage zero is the zero-step intervention. Later stages inherit all compatible prior parameters, with no gradient access to newly written target associations.
trained_policy: Adam with current owner facts and replay of all retained current sources. Trainer sees no future or retention tasks, outcomes, domain labels or family labels.
retention_policy: For stages after zero, execute the new stage's old-entity retention tasks on the previous trained release before appending new facts, and compare identical tasks itemwise after the trained release. Also retain every other intervention's retention readout.
decisions: The exact typed values must match independently recomputed owner facts. A decision is sum(coefficient * scalar(readout)) > threshold; a missing or invalid read makes the decision unavailable.
future_gain: Report trained-minus-frozen and trained-minus-zero paired read and decision counts separately for every stage and representation, never infer gain only from fitting loss or post-fit accuracy.
storage_policy: Retain and count source owner, all native/original artifacts, full explicit catalogs where present, support, lineage, and experimental evidence. Catalog-free refers only to the byte model payload and does not imply system-wide parameter-only storage or compression.
resource_policy: Full observed episode wall includes training, reads, publication, communication, evidence writes and shutdown. Do not add nested phase durations again. Report sampled RSS/storage byte-time as estimates with coverage gaps; unknown exact dimensions remain unknown.
scientific_scope: Three sequential authored task/domain cohorts are not three independent trials, and repeated reads are not IID samples. Written-support recall and new task composition do not establish unseen-address inference or open-world program discovery.
